programme.desc: An emotional intervention on Dr. Phil's stage: Siblings Sarah and PJ say for the past two years their mom, Kim, chose alcohol and pills over her four children. With father Pete headed to prison for mail fraud in a few weeks, the family is falling apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Samantha & sister Sarah say mom, Stacy, is a successful teacher & behaviorist, but when it comes to 33-year-old brother, Ben, it's another story. Stacy says teaching Ben how to pay bills and to eat his veggies helps Ben. Ben says he's just stuck in a rut.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Caylee Anthony's mom, Casey Anthony, has been named a person of interest in the case of the missing 3-year-old. Many fear the worst has happened. Dr. Phil examines the psychological aspects of the story that continues to grip America's imagination.

programme.title: Junior
programme.desc: Reflecting our society, the world of junior hockey is obsessed with competition. Taking in one complete season with the Baie-Comeau Drakkar, this film reveals the daily lives of managers and players on this Quebec Major Junior Hockey League team.

programme.title: How They Saw Us Wings On Her Shoulder
programme.desc: This is a 1943 recruitment film. Although it specifically promises women jobs in post-war aviation, its primary message is that women fulfill support positions "so that men might fly."

programme.title: Nails
programme.desc: A blacksmith is seen labouring at his forge, shaping nails from single strands of steel rods. It then shifts from this setting to the roar of a twentieth-century nail mill, where machines, cut, and pound the steel rods faster than the eye can follow.

programme.title: Voices Across The Water
programme.desc: ‘Voices Across the Water’ follows two master boat builders as they practise their art and find a way back to balance and healing.

programme.title: Ill Find A Way
programme.desc: When nine-year-old Nadia is allowed to attend a regular school, she knows the kids will tease her but she'll "find a way to deal with it." Nadia has spina bifida, a congenital condition that has caused a lack of sensation from the knees down.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the second round of qualifying, ninjas including Jesse "Flex" Labreck, Abel Gonzalez, Jamie "Captain NBC" Rahn and Daniel Gil face up to six challenging obstacles, including Ring Chaser and Rib Run, which are new to the course this year.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the third round of qualifying, ninjas including Jessie Graff, Najee Richardson, Michelle Warnky and Adam Rayl face up to six challenging obstacles, including the high-flying Beehive, which is new to the course this year.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior
programme.desc: In the final round of qualifying, ninjas including Meagan Martin, Joe Moravsky, Tiana Webberley, Michael Torres and the Cowboy Ninja Lance Pekus face up to six challenging obstacles, including Off the Hook, Spinning Bridge and the new Sideways.

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu
programme.desc: Mitch sauve de la noyade Cassie Cole, une présentatrice d'un célèbre talk-show télévisé. Caroline et CJ adoptent un chien errant qui nageait dans l’océan. L’animal leur rappelle Stephanie.

programme.title: Baywatch - Alerte à Malibu
programme.desc: Après que Caroline, Neely et Manny aient sauvé trois jeunes de la noyade, Caroline part à la recherche du mystérieux jeune homme qui leur est venu en aide. L’ex-mari de Neely refait surface et elle se demande pourquoi elle l’avait quitté.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Le service d’enquête criminelle naval fait appel à des experts en criminalistique pour résoudre trois meurtres troublants. Leur devise : Aux vivants, nous devons le respect, alors qu’aux morts, nous devons la vérité.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Les experts en engins explosifs sont sur la piste de poseurs de bombes.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Les empoisonneurs sont les tueurs les plus retors. Ils sont aussi les plus dangereux. Les spécialistes examinent des cas non résolus et appliquent de nouvelles méthodes pour identifier des meurtriers.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: L’analyse d’ADN permet de redonner la liberté à trois hommes qui ont vécu plusieurs années derrière les barreaux et qui ont payé pour des crimes qu’ils n’avaient pas commis.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Detectives
programme.desc: Cacher un cadavre n’est pas toujours facile. C’est pourquoi plusieurs meurtriers sont tentés de maquiller la scène de leur crime. Ainsi, les enquêteurs croiront peut-être qu’il s’agit d’un suicide ou d’un accident.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 3

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 3

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 3
programme.desc: Le Docteur et Martha arrivent sur la planète Nouvelle Terre, dans le lointain futur. Découvrant des cités sous le joug des sinistres Pharamacists, ils doivent s'engager sur la mystérieuse Autoroute afin de percer le terrible secret au cœur de la ville.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 3
programme.desc: Dans le New-York des années 1930, en pleine Grande dépression, les humains disparaissent des rues de la ville. De sauvages hommes-cochons se dissimulent dans les égouts. Au sommet de l'Empire State Building, les ennemis jurés du Docteur sont à l'œuvre.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Saison 3
programme.desc: Alors que l'empire Dalek s'établit dans le New York des années 30, Martha se bat pour rester en vie au sommet de l'Empire State Building, tandis que le Docteur se voit contraint de former une alliance contre-nature.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 3

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 3
programme.desc: Lupin and Jigen are out at sea attempting to retrieve the gold inside a sunken pirate ship. However, a female pirate gang interrupts their retrieval mission and both parties leave empty-handed.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 3
programme.desc: Lupin and his gang are in South Africa to receive a nautical chart from a retired Nazi that shows the location of a sunken Nazi treasure. However, two young German soldiers interrupt the exchange and a skirmish ensues.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 3
programme.desc: Lupin and his gang are in the small city of San Pico in Central America. However, the city was in the midst of a war between the Government Forces and the Guerilla Army. Leading the Guerilla Army is Jigen's old army pal, Giranco.

programme.title: Lupin the 3rd: Part 3
programme.desc: Unsurprisingly, Fujiko had once betrayed her heist partner Garb, known as the Grim Reaper, and left him for dead. Garb, who has seemingly returned from the dead, is determined to kill Fujiko and has an uncanny ability to dodge bullets with ease.
